title: Bus Trip to the Outskirts of Mallworld
content: Anyone else experience a dream about a long bus trip where the people with you are either on the way to the main mall or on the way to someplace else? It seems that a familiar location in my Mallworld is a massive national park area with lots of bare granite rock cliffs and mountains. A fantasic view but unsanely high and deep dropoffs on the sides of the roads. I had a partially lucid dream last night where I clearly remember a sense of urgency in trying to get back on the bus. Seems I was lucid enough that I accidentally phased out of the bus as it was rounding the corner around a strangely familiar tree lined roundabout. Another dream character or fellow dreamer and I were trying to figure out how to either get on the bus again or walk our way back to the entrance of the "national park". Surprisingly I became lucid and tried to fly to some sort of large sculpture up on a hill, but the dreamworld lost stability and fell apart before I could fly more. Anyone else experience that as well? Does it feel like someone is watching and stopping you from retaining lucidity? Or is it just the usual thing that can happen to novice dream travelers?
